newsitem.title: INDIA: Alcatel India venture to raise equity.
newsitem.headline: Alcatel India venture to raise equity.

text.p: An Indian subsidiary of French telecommunications and engineering giant Alcatel Alsthom plans to increase its equity base by 30 percent to 130 million rupees ($3.63 million), a senior company official said on Thursday.

"We plan a 30 percent expansion of the equity base later this year," Alcatel Business Systems India's chief operating officer Arnaud Soubelet told Reuters at the opening of the firm's New Delhi office.

The Indian subsidiary, a joint venture between Alcatel Alsthom and India's United Telecoms Ltd, was set up in 1995 with a 100 million rupee equity base to make telephones and private switching equipment.
Alcatel holds 51 percent of the firm's equity while its Indian partner holds the rest. Soubelet said the additional equity would come from the two shareholders in the same ratio.
He said the firm planned to raise its five percent share of the Indian market to 20 percent over the next five years. ($1=35.8 rupees)
